business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Procurement of Battery-Grade Lithium Carbonate Powder

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code doctrine; unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinctions for this entity)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-China Bilateral Investment Treaty, signed 30 May 1984, in force 2 April 1985
France-China Double Taxation Agreement, signed 30 May 1984, as amended by Protocols of 3 December 2004 and 26 November 2013
France-Chile Double Taxation Agreement, signed 20 October 2004, in force 24 October 2012
France-Australia Double Taxation Agreement, signed 28 April 1976, as amended by Protocol of 20 September 2010
EU-China Comprehensive Agreement on Investment (CAI), initialled 30 December 2020; ratification suspended by the European Parliament since 20 May 2021; NOT IN FORCE

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF) Articles L. 561-2, L. 561-2-2 (beneficial owner definition and UBO register), L. 561-5, L. 561-6 (customer due diligence), L. 561-10 (politically exposed persons), L. 574-1 (sanctions violations); Décret n° 2017-1094 of 12 June 2017 (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs, RBE); Loi n° 2016-1691 of 9 December 2016 (Sapin II); Loi n° 2018-898 of 23 October 2018; Loi n° 2020-1721 of 29 December 2020 transposing EU Directive 2018/843 (AMLD5); EU Regulation 2015/847 on information accompanying transfers of funds; ACPR and Tracfin AML/CFT guidance; French ministerial orders implementing EU and UN restrictive measures (fonds gelés)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Statutory Articles of Association (Statuts constitutifs) executed as notarial deed or as sous-seing privé with registered electronic signature
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French notary (Conseil supérieur du notariat) or the shareholders/authorized attorney-in-fact
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille not required for domestic French act; foreign shareholder resolutions and powers of attorney attached to the file require apostille in the state of issue plus certified sworn translation into French

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Apostilled Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing certificate of any foreign corporate shareholder or ultimate parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the source country (e.g., Chinese State Administration for Market Regulation, ASIC Australia, Chilean Chamber of Commerce registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention of 5 October 1961) affixed by the competent authority of the issuing state, followed by certified sworn translation by a French court-appointed translator (traducteur expert près une cour d'appel)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the ultimate beneficial owner's valid national identity document or passport and proof of residential address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority of the UBO's country of residence (certified by notary, municipality, or consular post where required)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for documents issued by non-EU Member States party to the Convention; EU Member State documents require administrative certification plus sworn translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds attestation for each shareholder and UBO funding the capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Deposit-taking banking institution of the shareholder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille and sworn French translation if issued by a non-EU bank; EU bank letters accepted with original stamp and sworn translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney (Pouvoir spécial) enabling a French attorney or legal broker to sign and file the incorporation dossier at the Guichet Unique
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or consular authority of the grantor's country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing state is a party to the 1961 Convention; Consular Legalization for non-member states

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors, and the ultimate parent against: (i) EU Sanctions Map and EFIS Consolidated List (EU restrictive measures); (ii) France's national 'Fonds gelés' ministerial orders; (iii) United Nations Security Council Consolidated List; (iv) OFAC SDN List (required by French banking counterparties irrespective of territorial applicability); (v) ACPR guidance on politically exposed persons under CMF Article L. 561-10 (foreign and domestic PEP, family members, known close associates). Screening is re-run quarterly and on each new SWIFT LC or wire transfer in accordance with EU Regulation 2015/847 travel-rule obligations. The battery-minerals arbitrage model requires enhanced due diligence on the ultimate commodity supplier's legal ownership chain to exclude conflict-minerals sanctions exposure.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises, operated by INPI at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; official name and trademark conflict search via INPI Data (data.inpi.fr) and Infogreffe/RNCS (Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal denomination (dénomination sociale) must be expressed in French-script Latin alphabet; a foreign brand mark or transliteration may be appended but the corporate name must not create confusion with existing registered entities or trademarks. The mandatory object clause (objet social) must be in French and is filed in the language of the registry; all constitutive documents and exhibits produced in a foreign language must be accompanied by a certified sworn translation into French. The legal form identifier 'SARL' or 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' must appear in all corporate correspondence and on the statutes.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Terms requiring prior ministerial or regulatory approval: 'Banque', 'Finance', 'Crédit', 'Assurance', 'Courtier', 'Gestion de fonds' (CMF licensing with ACPR)
Terms creating false public-entity status: 'Consul', 'Ambassade', 'Trésor public', 'Palais de justice', 'Police', 'Gendarmerie' (Articles R. 123-93 and R. 123-94 Code de commerce)
Terms implying a regulated status without approval: 'Mutuelle', 'Coopératif', 'Agréé', 'Certifié', 'Label'
Names identical or confusingly similar to an existing trademark or company denomination recorded in RNCS/INPI, exposing the formation to an invalidity action before the judicial court
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Under the Guichet Unique regime effective 1 January 2023, a name is cleared automatically upon filing of the complete incorporation dossier; the optional INPI 'préemption de dénomination' service (statutory fee EUR 20) reserves a denomination for 90 days and is primarily used when publication or financing steps precede registration. Upon a formal rejection, the filer receives a reasoned refusal from the INPI-verified registrar; the filer may (i) correct the name and immediately resubmit through the Guichet Unique; (ii) within 10 days of the refusal, file a motion before the presiding judge of the Tribunal judiciaire competent for the relevant Greffe du tribunal de commerce (Article R. 123-437 Code de commerce); or (iii) initiate a third-party opposition if a conflicting trademark owner opposes. Counsel response benchmark is 5 to 15 business days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable for a wholesale trading SARL when implemented through a licensed commercial domiciliation agent under Article L. 123-11-7 Code de commerce, providing a legal seat, physical mail handling, and a meeting room entitlement. A virtual office alone is permissible without employees, but the siège social must correspond to a verifiable locus in France for civil procedure, tax notices, and creditor opposition; the DGFIP may disregard a purely nominal domiciliation under the abuse-of-law doctrine. The battery-metals trading model with LC and wire settlement requires a domiciliation contract with a commercial-class address rather than a shared mailbox service.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: approximately 15–25% probability of an unannounced physical inspection by URSSAF or DGFIP within the first fiscal year, rising to roughly 35% before the third year if turnover exceeds EUR 2 million, headcount remains zero, and the domiciliation is purely passive. A registered domiciliation bureau with a minimum 10 m² meeting space, permanent signage, board-room availability, and annual renewal documentation reduces the inspection risk below 10%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal due diligence and drafting of SARL statutes, RBE/UBO disclosure, and complete Guichet Unique incorporation filing (Paris bar flat fee, mid-market)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French law firm / Avocat inscrit au barreau de Paris
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: EUR 2,500 fixed fee for standard SARL formation with foreign corporate shareholder and UBO statement

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registrar filing, registry rights, and greffe tax (droits et frais de greffe) for SARL incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce (via INPI Guichet Unique)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per Décret relatif aux tarifs des greffiers (approx. EUR 230 including VAT)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the legal announcement (avis de constitution) in the Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed JAL publisher in the department of the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory ceiling for annonces légales: EUR 0.08–0.12 per character plus flat regulatory tax; mid-range fixed quote EUR 160

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI denomination preemption and trademark/company-name conflict search (RNCS + INPI data)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: INPI statutory fee EUR 20 for the official preemption option plus market-rate conflict search report of EUR 85

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified sworn translation into French of foreign corporate records, certificates of incorporation, good standing, and identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Traducteur expert près une cour d'appel (court-appointed certified translator)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing expert tariff: EUR 100–180 per standard page; 4–6 documents estimated

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization fees for foreign-sourced documents (Hague seals, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of source states)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of each foreign issuing state
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fees of issuing authorities: USD 30–60 per document; 4 documents estimated

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office / commercial domiciliation contract for 12 months with meeting-room entitlement in Paris or Lyon business district
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed commercial domiciliation company (Article L. 123-11-7 Code de commerce)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate: EUR 90–180 per month excluding option of meeting room use

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Professional bank account opening and AML/KYC compliance package including banking due diligence file preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French licensed bank or payment institution (AML/KYC desk)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for account setup with enhanced KYB/UBO file: EUR 250–400 plus bank's initial deposit fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preliminary sectoral screening for battery-metals import classification, ISIC 4662/NAICS 423510 compliance memo, and EU customs/dual-use trigger review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed fee EUR 300 for a written screening memorandum

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Code de commerce, Book II; specifically Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10, L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL) and R.223-1 to R.223-29; supplemented by Code civil Articles 1832 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce acting as registrar for the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), with the electronic one-stop-shop operated by INPI (Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Demande d'immatriculation au Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés, filed electronically via Guichet Unique, accompanied by statuts constitutifs and annexes; registration is evidenced by the Kbis extract
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; SARL may be formed with a nominal capital of €1. Cash contributions must be fully subscribed and paid in at signature and blocked in a French credit institution or with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations until registration; funds are released to the gérant only upon presentation of the Kbis extract. In-kind contributions must be fully transferred and, if their value exceeds legal thresholds, valued by a commissaire aux apports.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the share subscriptions and cash contributions disclosed in the Articles of Association are accepted in full, that the share capital is validly subscribed and satisfied, and that the corresponding shares are allotted to the subscribing associates. RESOLVED, that the registered office stated in Article 2 of the Articles is hereby adopted as the Company's statutory seat and administrative centre. RESOLVED, that the natural person mentioned in the Articles is appointed Gérant and vested with full powers of management and representation, and power to complete registration, open bank accounts, and enter preliminarily into contracts consistent with the corporate object of wholesale distribution of battery-grade lithium carbonate. This resolution is effective as an administrative act incident to the incorporation filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-filing availability check and corporate name clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI data.inpi.fr; RCS and trademark legal search
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search the national company register, EU trade mark database and commercially available domain names to screen identical or confusingly similar corporate names, trademarks and protected signs. Select the corporate name and confirm that the intended corporate object, wholesale trade of battery-grade lithium carbonate, is lawful in France. Proceed with the chosen name in the draft Articles of Association.
required_dossiers: Print-out or documented screenshot of the RCS/INPI name search
EUIPO or INPI trademark search result, if any
Record of registered office address authority or lease intent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a prior right is found, abandon or modify the proposed name, re-run the clearance check and adopt a distinctive alternative before filing; no public corrective remedy is required at this stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of Articles of Association (statuts constitutifs)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding associates and legal counsel; notarial deed is not mandatory unless real property is contributed
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the statuts in compliance with Articles L.223-6 to L.223-10 of the Code de commerce. Include legal form, company name, duration, registered office address, corporate object, share capital amount, nominal value of shares, share allocation, management clauses, gérant powers, decision-making rules, and the apportionment of profits and losses. All associates must sign personally or through an attorney-in-fact holding an authenticated power of attorney; electronic signature by a trusted third party is permissible.
required_dossiers: Statuts constitutifs signed by all associates
Certified copy of each associate's identity document
Declaration of non-conviction for each appointed gérant
Authenticated power of attorney if signature is given through a representative
Proof of right to use the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar later queries a statutory clause, amend the Articles by an extraordinary general meeting or supplementary resolution, then re-submit through Guichet Unique. Prior to filing, any associate may require the correction of an error by unanimous consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit and blocking of cash share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the future SARL and deposit all cash contributions. Obtain a bank attestation stating the account holder, the amount deposited and the blocking condition. If non-cash contributions are made, attach the contribution valuation report or provide for appointment of a commissaire aux apports when the value exceeds statutory thresholds.
required_dossiers: Attestation de dépôt des fonds issued by the bank or Caisse des Dépôts
Individual statement of cash subscriptions signed by each associate
In-kind contribution valuation report, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the attestation contains an irregularity such as an incorrect company name or amount, require the bank to issue a corrected attestation before the incorporation filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legal publication of company formation notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales authorized in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and publish a legal notice stating the corporate name, legal form, share capital, registered office, corporate object, duration, identity of the gérant, and the RCS registry where the company will be registered. Obtain the publisher's attestation de parution after publication.
required_dossiers: Legal notice text approved by counsel
Attestation de parution issued by the legal announcements newspaper
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the legal gazette refuses the notice due to form or content, correct the wording and republish. If an error is later discovered in the published text, publish a corrective notice before or upon registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing of incorporation through Guichet Unique and RCS registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises; registration by Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online company-creation declaration at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr or through a certified API partner. Attach the statuts, bank attestation, legal publication certificate, identity documents, declarations of non-conviction, registered office proof and any powers of attorney. Pay the state filing fee. The greffe reviews the file and issues the Kbis extract after registration, together with SIREN, SIRET and the statutory NAF/APE code.
required_dossiers: Electronic filing receipt from Guichet Unique
Signed statuts constitutifs
Attestation de dépôt des fonds
Attestation de parution of legal announcement
Proof of registered office or domiciliation contract
Declaration of non-condemnation for each gérant
Identity documents of associates and gérant
Power of attorney if filing through a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffe issues a formal query or refuses registration, regularize by providing the requested document or by amending the Articles. The correction is re-submitted through Guichet Unique. A refusal can be appealed before the judge supervising the RCS register within legal delays.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, INSEE, DGFIP and URSSAF
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the final Kbis extract and verify the accuracy of SIREN, SIRET and APE code. The greffe publishes the registration in BODACC automatically. Tax and social security registrations are activated through automatic data transmission. Confirm intra-Community VAT registration if not automatically completed; if import or export operations are planned, retain the EORI number or request one from customs.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract
Confirmation of SIREN and SIRET assignment
BODACC publication receipt
VAT/EORI registration confirmation where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If BODACC publication is omitted or delayed, write to the greffe requesting the correction and re-publication. If tax or social identifiers are not transmitted, send a correction request through Guichet Unique.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organization of statutory registers, first general meeting and bank account release
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gérant(s) and associates' general meeting; banking institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Establish the statutory records required by law: share register, minutes book, decisions register, and file of periodic accounts. Convene the first associates' meeting to ratify the pro-forma first board resolution, confirm the gérant's appointment if not already definitive, and authorize opening of the operational bank account. Present the Kbis extract to the bank to lift the capital deposit block and credit the SARL's account.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first associates' general meeting
Copy of the Kbis extract and statuts
Corporate bank account opening document
Resolution authorizing gérant to operate the account
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses to release funds due to a discrepancy between the statuts and Kbis, obtain a rectified Kbis from the greffe. If a share register is missing a required entry, remedy by correcting the register and adding the proper entries before external verification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL), acting under the Préfet for installations classées pour la protection de l'environnement (ICPE); DRIEETS for labour inspection and occupational health; SDIS for fire safety
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Récépissé de déclaration d'installation classée pour la protection de l'environnement if physical storage or handling thresholds are exceeded; otherwise attestation de non-classement ICPE. No separate industrial manufacturing permit is required for a wholesale trading entity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Inspection de l'environnement – DREAL, under the authority of the Préfet de département
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA is not automatically mandated for wholesale trading of packaged battery-grade lithium carbonate. A site-specific screening under ICPE is required only if the company operates a physical warehouse or storage facility; such facility is generally classified as 'Non classé' or, at most, in the 'Déclaration' tier. A full Environmental Impact Assessment report is not required unless the specific facility falls under one of the enumerated ICPE 'Autorisation' or 'Enregistrement' categories due to aggregate storage volumes or ancillary dangerous-goods handling.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: There is no manufacturing process discharge. Any wastewater from cleaning or stormwater runoff at a warehouse must comply with the general discharge standards of the Code de l'environnement and applicable municipal sewer pre-treatment limits, notably pH between 6.5 and 8.5, total suspended solids below local thresholds, and no undissolved lithium salt discharge. Ventilation or ambient air emissions, if any, must respect workplace exposure limits under Code du travail Articles R.4222-8 and R.4412-27; dusts of lithium carbonate in handling areas must be controlled to prevent inhalation exposure. Hazardous waste, damaged packaging and contaminated residues must be traced under French waste-control obligations with a bordereau de suivi des déchets where applicable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety and structural load inspections are required for any occupied commercial or warehouse premises, including an inspection by the SDIS for fire resistance, exits, extinguishers and emergency signage. New electrical installations require an attestation de conformité by CONSUEL. Racking or mechanical handling areas require a structural load certificate. The company must prepare a Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques Professionnels (DUERP) and provide occupational medical follow-up before employees are exposed to chemical or powder hazards.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Ministry of Public Accounts and Budget; online portals: impots.gouv.fr and formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; customs oversight for imports/exports is exercised by the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The foreign-owned SARL registers through the national single electronic portal (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) by filing the unified registration/incorporation form (M0) with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce. The Registrar assigns the SIREN/SIRET; the competent Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) enters the company into the VAT taxpayer register and allocates a French intra-Community VAT number (FR + 11 digits / IFU). Non-resident shareholders and managers must provide certified identity documents, proof of a registered office in France, bank references, and AML/KYC documentation; there is no minimum capital requirement. VAT registration is effective from commencement of taxable activities, and notification is delivered via the taxpayer's online professional account.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under Article 239 bis AA of the French General Tax Code (CGI), an SARL carrying on an industrial or commercial activity may elect, for a non-renewable maximum period of five fiscal years, to be taxed under the transparent 'sociétés de personnes' regime, unless the election would result in tax avoidance by a member holding at least 50% of the capital. No US-style check-the-box election exists under French law; the SARL's default remains entity-level corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés under Article 206-1 CGI), at the standard 25% rate with a reduced 15% rate on the first €42,500 of taxable profit, subject to statutory conditions. Hybrid mismatch rules under EU Directive (EU) 2017/952 (ATAD 2) and OECD BEPS Action 2 apply to cross-border structures where a foreign check-the-box classification creates double non-taxation or double deductions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée – TVA) governed by CGI Articles 256 to 283 and EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold for registration: any independent taxable economic activity carried on in France by the SARL requires immediate VAT registration. For intra-EU distance sales of goods into France, the €10,000 annual pan-European threshold (aggregated cross-border B2C supplies) triggers French VAT; imports into French customs territory attract VAT at clearance under Article 291 CGI irrespective of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory structured e-invoicing and e-reporting regime under Article 289 CGI as amended by the 2022 Finance Act and Decree No. 2022-1298. Large enterprises and mid-caps (ETI) must issue and receive structured e-invoices from 1 September 2026; all SMEs/VSEs from 1 September 2027. Transmission occurs via a certified Partner Dematerialization Platform (PDP) or the free Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) using Factur-X/FNFE, UBL, or CII formats, with transaction datasets forwarded to DGFiP in near real time for fiscal reconciliation. France does not impose pre-transaction fiscal stamping or central clearance authorization; instead, the PPF/PDP architecture enables continuous e-reporting, and platform-to-platform APIs are governed by the Dynamic Sharing Protocol (DSP). Every invoice must identify both parties by SIREN and FR VAT number.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Article 262-I-1° CGI zero-rates supplies of goods exported by the SARL to destinations outside the EU, provided the exporter holds conclusive documentary proof that the goods physically left EU customs territory within the prescribed dispatch period. For the battery-grade lithium carbonate arbitrage model, each export consignment requires a complete export-proof file (dossier de preuves) covering sale, transport, and customs exit. Services directly connected to exports and B2B services rendered to third-country recipients fall outside French VAT or qualify for zero-rating under Articles 259 A and 262-I-2° CGI.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (Déclaration d'Échanges de Biens / EXA authentication in the DGDDI SDE/ICS system)
Bill of Lading (Connaissement) or Air Waybill / CMR consignment note evidencing physical departure from EU territory
Commercial invoice and Incoterm (typically FOB/CIF for battery-grade lithium carbonate) evidencing transfer of title outside France
Bank payment evidence (SWIFT MT103) or Inward Remittance Certificate (certificat domiciliaire)
Warehouse departure certificates or third-party logistics records supporting physical exit in the export-proof file
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGFiP conducts targeted flow-matching audits of export zero-rating files; unsupported or false zero-rating triggers reassessment of undeclared VAT, late-payment interest of 0.20% per month under Article 1727 CGI, bad-faith penalty of 40% and fraudulent-maneuvers penalty of 80% under Articles 1728 and 1729 CGI, denial of input VAT deduction, and criminal liability for tax fraud under Article 1741 CGI (up to five years' imprisonment and a fine up to €500,000 or twice the sums evaded). The retroactive clawback period is three years from the end of the reporting year under Article L.169 of the Livre des Procédures Fiscales, extending to six years for unreported transactions and up to ten years for deliberately concealed activity; customs penalties under Articles 410 et seq. of the Code des Douanes additionally apply to false export declarations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains full capital account convertibility and current account convertibility under EU regulations and national law. Profit remittances to foreign shareholders are unrestricted and may be effected without prior approval, subject only to standard tax filing and beneficial ownership disclosure requirements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender of export or import proceeds is required under French or EU law. All transactions are subject to free convertibility at market rates. Import and export receipts must be reported to the Banque de France for statistical purposes within ten working days, but funds may remain in foreign currency accounts without forced conversion.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs are not viable for cross-border corporate treasury operations in France due to strict AML and payment services regulations. All liquidity clearing must be conducted through licensed traditional correspondent banking channels.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of directors or authorized signatories is mandatory for initial KYC interviews and account opening. Remote onboarding is not permitted for French SARL entities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained source of funds for lithium carbonate procurement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supplier contracts, purchase orders, invoices, shipping documents, and end-use certificates confirming legitimate commercial transaction
Corporate registry extracts, shareholder declarations, and identification documents of directors and ultimate beneficial owners

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions screening flags on foreign counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive due diligence reports and legal opinions confirming absence of sanctions exposure

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections are routed via SWIFT MT103 wires using purpose codes 'EQUITY_CONTRIBUTION' or 'LOAN_REPAYMENT'. All transactions require board resolution approval and supporting source-of-funds documentation. Verification is performed through the bank's compliance and KYC departments.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for battery-grade lithium carbonate procurement are executed via SWIFT MT103 for direct correspondent bank transfers or issuance of Commercial Letters of Credit. Payments are processed in USD or EUR at prevailing market rates with full FX conversion.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements deposit (dépôt des comptes annuels; balance sheet, income statement, notes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via INPI Guichet Unique (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders must approve accounts within six months of fiscal year-end; accounts filed with the registry within one month after approval. For a calendar-year SARL: approval by 30 June and deposit by 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing gives rise to a fine of up to EUR 1,500 per manager, coercive payment ordered by the registrar, and formal notice procedures. Two consecutive years of non-filing may trigger RCS strike-off, and continued default can lead to judicial dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' meeting minutes approving annual accounts and disposing of management discharge (procès-verbal d'assemblée générale ordinaire)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate minute book; not transmitted to a public authority unless separately requested or attached to a registry filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Once per fiscal year, in all cases no later than six months after fiscal year-end (calendar-year SARL: by 30 June of the following year). A court extension may exceptionally be obtained for a maximum of one additional month.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene the meeting may authorize any shareholder to petition the commercial court to appoint an agent to convene it; managers remain liable for losses caused by non-compliance and the annual accounts cannot be registered in due legal form.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return package (liasse fiscale no. 2065-SD and related 2050-series schedules)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a fiscal year ending 31 December: file on the second business day after 1 May of the following year (calendar-year SARL norm). For a non-calendar fiscal year: file by the second business day after 30 April. E-filing is mandatory.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers the automatic 10% late-filing penalty, increased to 40% if a formal notice is issued; late-payment interest accrues monthly at 0.40% and the tax authority may issue an enforced collection demand.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner declaration update (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs / DBE) on any change in direct or indirect ownership or control
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via INPI Guichet Unique (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after any change to the beneficial ownership chain, including transfer of SARL shares or modification of control. No separate annual UBO filing is required where data is unchanged.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update the UBO declaration exposes the legal entity and managers to a fine of up to EUR 15,000, possible suspension of voting rights of the undisclosed owner, and a negative impact on registry standing; recidivist omissions may support RCS strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: RCS data confirmation and event-driven amendment filings (mise à jour du registre: registered office, statutory managers, corporate purpose, activity codes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via INPI Guichet Unique (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Any change to RCS particulars must be filed within 30 days of the event. Annual validation of unchanged data is effected through the annual accounts filing; no standalone yearly paper return exists.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-registration of a material change is punishable by a fine of up to EUR 1,500 and the court may order compliance under penalty; false registry declarations may be prosecuted as forgery and lead to register rectification and liability for damages.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A French SARL must appoint a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) if it exceeds at least two of three thresholds at year-end: balance-sheet total over EUR 4,000,000; net turnover excluding tax over EUR 8,000,000; average workforce over 50 employees. A SARL may also be required to appoint an auditor when it holds a subsidiary or if ordered by a shareholder or court.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, PCG) under ANC Regulation No. 2014-03, codified in the French Commercial Code. IFRS is not permitted as the statutory accounting framework for a standalone French SARL; financial statements must be prepared in euros and submitted in the required official annual-accounts format.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The UBO declaration is filed initially at registration and updated within 30 days after any change in beneficial ownership or control. France does not require an annually repeated UBO declaration when no change occurs; the annual accounts filing and RCS data validation cycle constitute the statutory annual confirmation mechanism. Each transfer of SARL shares must be recorded in the company's register of securities, reported in the annual shareholders' meeting, and used to determine whether an updated UBO declaration is due.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Registre des associés / parts sociales)
Register of Directors (Registre des décisions de la gérance)
Minute Book (Registre des procès-verbaux des assemblées)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 480 – USD 1,600 per annum for outsourced business domiciliation/registered office services in France, higher for central Paris or premium commercial-address arrangements
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 when the SARL is below compulsory audit thresholds; USD 9,000 – USD 32,000 for a mid-sized SARL when statutory audit is required, excluding international group consolidated audit requirements

stage_6.entry_description: Company identification: legal name, SIREN, NAF/APE code 4662Z, registered office, fiscal year dates; also seal of the tax representative for entities without permanent establishment.
stage_6.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a French SARL, the entity is a French tax resident and files in France; a non-resident shareholder must not be filed as taxpayer, but must be disclosed in Cadre 'Composition du capital social' (2057) if holding >5%.
